site.title: Orgo | Organize your life with clarity
site.description: Plan, journal, and manage your days in one calm workspace built for focus.

footer.tagline: Calm planning, thoughtful writing, and bilingual product systems designed with care.

hero.title: Plan clearly. Write intentionally. Move through the week with calm.
hero.description: Orgo brings priorities, notes, and weekly rituals into one focused space so you can stay organized without turning your life into a dashboard.

cards.focus_body: See what matters now, what can wait, and what deserves a note.
cards.journal_body: Turn loose thoughts into decisions, next steps, and a quieter end of day.
cards.sync_body: Keep personal planning and team-facing work close, without mixing everything together.

capture.title: The work behind the work finally has a home
capture.description: Planning is rarely just tasks. Orgo gives calendars, loose notes, and priorities one calm surface so context stops leaking between apps.
capture.point_one_body: Quick notes, ideas, and reminders land somewhere trustworthy before they disappear.
capture.point_two_body: Keep today, this week, and later work visible without overwhelming the page.
capture.point_three_body: Localized experiences help bilingual teams and personal routines feel natural.

rhythm.title: Build a week that feels deliberate instead of reactive
rhythm.description: Move from rough capture to a clear weekly plan, then back into reflection without losing the thread of what changed.
rhythm.point_one_body: Start from a lightweight review instead of reopening a dozen tabs.
rhythm.point_two_body: Make room for deep work, admin, and recovery before the week runs away from you.
rhythm.point_three_body: Notes stay close to plans so reflection turns into better decisions.

journal.title: Writing and execution belong closer together
journal.description: Journaling is more useful when it can shape the next decision. Orgo keeps writing reflective without isolating it from action.
journal.point_one_body: Turn a line in your journal into a commitment worth tracking.
journal.point_two_body: Important reasoning stays attached to the plan it influenced.
journal.point_three_body: Capture what shifted, what shipped, and what deserves tomorrow's attention.

workflow.title: A calmer operating system for the days that matter
workflow.description: Orgo encourages a simple cycle you can repeat every week without turning productivity into maintenance.
workflow.capture_body: Catch ideas, reminders, and half-formed thoughts before they vanish.
workflow.clarify_body: Shape rough inputs into clean priorities, quiet notes, and intentional plans.
workflow.commit_body: Protect the work that matters and leave room for reality to happen.
workflow.reflect_body: End the cycle with memory, not guesswork, so next week starts smarter.

pricing.title: Start with the essentials, grow into a deeper system
pricing.description: The homepage gives the shape of the offer. The pricing page holds the fuller detail once plans are finalized.
pricing.starter_point_two: A clean home for notes, priorities, and routines
pricing.pro_point_one: Richer workflows and deeper review habits
pricing.pro_point_three: Built for people who want one serious system

proof.title: Orgo fits the people doing the invisible work of staying organized
proof.description: Instead of pretending every customer looks the same, Orgo is shaped around a few very real patterns of work.
proof.founders_body: Hold decisions, weekly priorities, and stray notes in one calm place before they spread across chat, docs, and task lists.
proof.founders_quote: Less tab juggling. More clarity about what matters this week.
proof.consultants_body: Keep client work, meeting notes, and personal planning close enough to support each other without collapsing together.
proof.consultants_quote: A system that respects both delivery and reflection.
proof.personal_body: Use Orgo as a lighter operating system for journaling, routines, and the quiet logistics that keep life moving.
proof.personal_quote: Structured enough to be useful, gentle enough to keep using.

cta.title: Bring your plans, notes, and next steps into one calm system
cta.description: Start with a lighter weekly rhythm today, then grow into deeper routines as Orgo evolves.
